html:
Given a valid JSON array of objects with integer quantity and integer price fields, parse it and return the sum of quantity*price. Counts and prices are nonnegative.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    "[{\"quantity\":3,\"price\":7},{\"quantity\":2,\"price\":4}]"
  ],
  "expected": 29
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    "[]"
  ],
  "expected": 0
}
Hint

Parse once and compute each row subtotal.

Complexity: O(input length) time and space
